## Definition of done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria checked (tests, or by hand: say which)
- [ ] Tests, and `ci_local.py` green (with Postgres)
- [ ] Migration works with the previous version, and has a downgrade (or: no data change)

- [ ] README, docs/ and CHANGELOG "Unreleased" updated
- [ ] Can be rolled back
